unitConventions.word: Use explicit *Pt fields for font, character spacing, paragraph spacing and paragraph indents; use *Mm for page, drawing and table geometry; use *Deg for angles. Never pass OOXML twips or EMU.
unitConventions.slide: Use *Mm for positions, sizes, padding and paragraph indents; use fontSize, *Pt for font, line and paragraph spacing; use *Deg for angles and *Ms for durations. Never pass EMU.
unitConventions.sheet: Use fontSize, rowHeightPt and marginsPt in points; columnWidthChars in spreadsheet character-width units; *Mm for drawing geometry and offsets; *Deg for angles. Never pass pixels, twips or EMU unless a field explicitly says so.
